trial_court: Senior Civil Judge, Rayachoty, H.M.O.P. No. 26 of 2015
case_name: Kommineni Radha vs Kommineni Gangadhar Naidu
facts_of_case: Petitioner is the wife of respondent who had filed D.O.P. No. 26 of 2015 before Senior Civil Judge, Rayachoty. Upon contest, the same came to be dismissed by the Senior Civil Judge, Rayachoty by order dated 04.10.2019. During pendency of the case, petitioner who was respondent therein has filed an application seeking interim maintenance and the Court had directed for payment of Rs.6,000/- per month for the petitioner and her two minor children.

legal_principles.principle: Even after dismissal of a divorce petition, if an interim order has not been formally withdrawn, it is obligatory on the part of the person who has suffered the order to keep paying the interim maintenance and expenses.
legal_principles.held: This court holds that even after dismissal of the divorce petition, if an interim order has not been formally withdrawn, it is obligatory on the part of the person who has suffered the order to keep paying the interim maintenance and expenses.
cited_cases: Parchuri Rajya Lakshmi vs Parchuri Viswa Sankara Prasad (1995) (1) ALT 628

outcome.final_order: The impugned order dated 23.07.2021 is set aside and the application I.A.(SR) No. 754 of 2021 is allowed.
